title: Absolutely adorable and sturdy!
text:
Absolutely adorable and sturdy!. Absolutely love this table and chair set! The set is so perfect for a princess themed room. The wood is good thick solid wood, not that fake compressed stuff others would use. The set was super easy to screw together just make sure you screw the legs all the way, if you dont the table or chair can seem wobbly as they are at an angle. So much better then Ikea furniture.
Very pleased with this purchase and would highly recommend this set.
